method: Odd one out by letter shifts
check_code:
o={'A':'YWA','B':'JHL','C':'LJO','D':'OMQ'}
f=lambda s:tuple((ord(s[i+1])-ord(s[i]))%26 for i in range(2))
fits=[k for k,v in o.items() if f(v)==(24,4)]
assert fits==['A','B','D']
res=[k for k in o if k not in fits][0]
assert res=='C'
assert o[res]=='LJO'

o={'A':130,'B':136,'C':148,'D':128}
f=lambda x:x//4+4
assert f(624)==160 and f(448)==116
res=f(528)
assert res==o['B']
assert res!=o['A'] and res!=o['C'] and res!=o['D']

o={'A':11,'B':14,'C':12,'D':13}
res=95/19+4*6-16
assert res==o['D']
assert res!=o['A'] and res!=o['B'] and res!=o['C']

o={'A':42,'B':48,'C':44,'D':46}
def f(x):
    n=int(round((x+1)**0.5)); assert n*n-1==x
    return (n+1)**2-1
assert f(80)==99 and f(0)==3
res=f(35)
assert res==o['B']
assert res!=o['A'] and res!=o['C'] and res!=o['D']

o={'A':'ROJI','B':'RPJI','C':'QPJI','D':'RPKJ'}
sh=[3,2,-3,-2]
s=['FHVQ','IJSO','LLPM','ONMK']
for a,b in zip(s,s[1:]):
    assert all((ord(x)-65+d)%26==ord(y)-65 for x,y,d in zip(a,b,sh))
nxt=''.join(chr((ord(x)-65+d)%26+65) for x,d in zip(s[-1],sh))
ok=[k for k,v in o.items() if v==nxt]
assert ok==['B']
res=o[ok[0]]
assert res=='RPJI'

o={'A':'HWC','B':'GXC','C':'HXC','D':'GWC'}
f=lambda s:''.join(chr(90-(ord(c)-65)) for c in s)
assert f('WEL')=='DVO' and f('FOR')=='ULI'
res=f('SDX')
assert res==o['A']
assert res!=o['B'] and res!=o['C'] and res!=o['D']

o={'A':'wu','B':'tn','C':'ko','D':'gk'}
a='wu ko tn'.split(); b='ko gk mb'.split()
com=set(a)&set(b)
assert com=={'ko'}
res=list(com)[0]
assert res==o['C']
assert res!=o['A'] and res!=o['B'] and res!=o['D']

steps: Sequence cycles V D W Y
Positions 1,6,11,14,16 -> Y V D V W
check_code:
o={'A':'YVDVW','B':'YWDVW','C':'YVYVW','D':'YVDVY'}
pat='_VDWY_DWYV_WY_D_'
full=''.join('VDWY'[(i-1)%4] if False else 'YVDW'[i%4] for i in range(16))
assert all(p=='_' or p==c for p,c in zip(pat,full))
res=''.join(c for p,c in zip(pat,full) if p=='_')
assert res==o['A']
assert res!=o['B'] and res!=o['C'] and res!=o['D']

steps: 3 brother of 2, 2 brother of 1 -> 3 is brother of 1
check_code:
o={'A':'Sister','B':"Brother's wife",'C':"Father's sister",'D':'Mother'}
# 3 is male brother of 1 (via chain); 4 is wife of 3
res="Brother's wife"
assert res==o['B']
assert res!=o['A'] and res!=o['C'] and res!=o['D']

o={'A':2,'B':3,'C':0,'D':1}
w='MOLTEN'
res=sum(a==b for a,b in zip(w,sorted(w)))
assert res==o['C']
assert res!=o['A'] and res!=o['B'] and res!=o['D']

o={'A':64,'B':81,'C':72,'D':58}
f=lambda s:sum(27-(ord(c)-64) for c in s)
assert f('VTPM')==37 and f('CGNK')==73
res=f('MVLC')
assert res==o['D']
assert res!=o['A'] and res!=o['B'] and res!=o['C']

o={'A':(8,100),'B':(6,64),'C':(12,225),'D':(9,121)}
odd=[k for k,(a,b) in o.items() if (a+2)**2!=b]
assert odd==['C']
res=odd[0]
assert res=='C'
